text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks~ Wait... Today's your birthday too, 
Ikuno. Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, do you think you can take it easy 
today? You were helping Tannhauser with 
her homework until late yesterday, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine, but... what about you, 
Nature-san? You were looking after 
Turbo-san the entire time too, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, honestly, I'm feeling the pressure~. 
Since you're working so hard, I can't go 
slacking off either, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's what I thought. So I 
prepared the perfect thing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Isn't that a hot springs magazine!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Heal your daily fatigue in milky-white 
hot springs." How about it? Sounds 
effective, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds so nice... Just closing 
your eyes, soaking for a long time—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's it. Quietly forgetting the hustle 
and bustle of everyday life—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's settled then. Since we share a 
birthday, let's take our time and enjoy it 
together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it at just daydreaming would be a 
waste! I would be delighted to accompany 
you!
